LESSON: HEALING OF THE PARALYTIC

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Miracles of Jesus Christ
Topic 3.3: Healing of the Paralytic

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Healing of the Paralytic. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: How does the healing of the paralytic build your faith in God?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. describe the healing of the paralytic
2. apply lessons learnt from the miracle in daily life
3. appreciate God’s power over sickness and disease

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: HEALING OF THE PARALYTIC
This lesson teaches Healing of the Paralytic for Grade 8 CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

STUDY STEPS
1. describe the healing of the paralytic
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. apply lessons learnt from the miracle in daily life
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
3. appreciate God’s power over sickness and disease
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Healing of the Paralytic using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Healing of the Paralytic above.
2. Explain Healing of the Paralytic to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Healing of the Paralytic.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Healing of the Paralytic with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Healing of the Paralytic important for a Grade 8 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How does the healing of the paralytic build your faith in God?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. describe the healing of the paralytic
2. apply lessons learnt from the miracle in daily life
3. appreciate God’s power over sickness and disease

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
